title: Auxiliary Power Unit — Firewall Panel and Drain Mast — Installation of the Reworked Standard
abstract: Retrofit of the reworked auxiliary power unit firewall panel and the repositioned compartment drain mast, ending the fluid pooling that has produced repeated corrosion findings and two ground smoke events.

sections.planning_reason: Scheduled inspections of the auxiliary power unit compartment produced forty-three corrosion findings on the firewall panel lower edge between 2014 and 2017, all at the same three fastener positions. The compartment drain path allows a residue of oil and water to stand on the panel edge, and the joint seal wicks it into the fastener holes. On two aircraft the standing residue reached the compartment heat source and produced smoke that entered the cabin through the aft galley area on the ground. Aircraft that are not modified remain exposed to both the corrosion finding and the smoke event.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin installs the reworked firewall panel with a formed lower edge that sheds fluid outboard, reseals the panel to frame joint, and repositions the compartment drain mast forty millimetres aft with an increased bore so that the compartment drains under all ground attitudes. The cowl latch is retained but its anchor nuts are renewed for the thicker joint, and the drain line support clamp is moved to the new mast position.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the auxiliary power unit is shut down, that the fire bottle is safetied and that the compartment is cool. Get access through the compartment doors in zones 391, 394 and 396. Remove the existing firewall panel following task AMM-Z-49-10-11-000-027-A. Remove the drain mast and blank the aperture. Drill the new mast position from the template and de-burr the hole. Install the mast and seal it. Install the panel D4910114423015 with the anchor nuts AGS522879K5 and torque them in the sequence given on drawing D49101112590. Install the seal at FIN 9606PB and check that the joint is continuous. Move the clamp D4910115671824 to the new mast position and re-support the drain line. Inspect and refit the heat shield at FIN 633PB and the cowl latch D4910112220209. Install the panel following task AMM-Z-49-10-11-400-027-A. Do the compartment drain flow check and the auxiliary power unit ground run.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to ZEPHYR-20, ZEPHYR-22 and ZEPHYR-24 aircraft not built to the reworked panel and mast standard. Aircraft delivered from the production cut-in already carry it.
sections.material_note: Kit K4910-1004-01 contains the firewall panel, the drain mast, the joint seal, the anchor nut set and the drill template for one aircraft. The template is returned after use. Most of the elapsed time is sealant cure and the aircraft can be released only after the drain flow check.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next base maintenance visit with tail cone access, or within 30 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
